preconditions.text: The GTELaunchpadV2Pair contract introduces a modified fee mechanism inside the _update function that reduces the reserve update amount directly instead of charging swap fees from the input amount as in standard Uniswap V2.; A trader performs a swap that moves the price away from equilibrium.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.
evidence: The GTELaunchpadV2Pair contract is a fork of the Uniswap V2 pair contract and introduces a modified fee mechanism inside the _update function. Instead of charging swap fees from the input amount (standard in Uniswap V2), the fork reduces the reserve update amount directly.

When a trader moves the price away from equilibrium and an arbitrageur backruns the trade, LPs in the fork lose even more value than in the reference. The reserve shaving mechanism amplifies arbitrage profit opportunities at the direct expense of LPs, effectively making LPs subsidize arbitrageurs.
